failure_summary.description: Selected a salient related entity matching only part of the clue instead of the best-supported referent for the complete clue.
Answered with an associated location or institution rather than the requested work title or state.

patch.reasoning: The skill already instructs agents to parse the answer slot and avoid related entities, but the failures show that broad guidance is not being applied consistently. Sharpen that existing check into an operational test: identify the requested referent, trace the direction of the relation, and test the candidate against the full clue.

edits.target: Before answering, parse the requested answer slot and all identifying relations or properties, then test the candidate against the complete clue. When snippets compete, prefer factual evidence that fits those details; keyword overlap in a title or heading, prominence, or a similar name alone is not enough. Do not substitute a related entity, example, remedy, or mechanism for the requested answer.
edits.content: Before answering, identify the requested answer slot and the grammatical referent of the clue (for example, a work, location, organization, or state). Trace each relationship in the direction asked: a place where a play is set is not the play, and an institution belonging to a state is not the state. Test the candidate against the complete clue and all identifying details, not just a salient phrase or nearby passage. For a fragment or ellipsis, use all supplied words to identify the best-supported complete referent rather than a prominent entity matching only a shorter substring. Reject candidates that are merely related to the requested referent.
